title: Yay, no chemical odor! Feels nice and looks great!
text:
Yay, no chemical odor! Feels nice and looks great!. I love this rug! The first thing I noticed and loved about this rug is that it doesn't have that strong dye smell that so many new items tend to have these days! Right out of the box, there was no chemical order.

It looks attractive and feels nice. I have had no pilling. I love the antique design. It goes nice with any decor.

product_metadata.title: Nourison Aria Oriental Vintage Area Rug, 7 Feet 10 Inches by 10 Feet (7'10" x 10'), Charcoal Grey
features: Spice up the décor in your home with Nourison. This rug is perfect for any room. Feel free to lay ontop of hard floors or carpet areas.
This rug is stain resistant, fade resistant, no shedding, and easy to clean
description: A richly ornamental medallion motif surrounded by an elegantly detailed decorative border. In subtle tones of soft charcoal grey, a truly sophisticated area rug that will bring a serene feeling of high fashion to that special room in your home. Expertly power loomed to create a distinctively burnished, low cut pile that mirrors the softly aged look of the finest antique carpets. Made from premium quality polypropylene yarns for superbly supple texture and years of resilient beauty.

details.Product Care Instructions: Vacuum regularly. Clean spills immediately by blotting with a clean damp sponge or cloth. Professional cleaning recommended.
